revision_note: Neither source directory is a Git checkout at review time; use per-file hashes and source snapshot digests as the baseline.

open-world:Tools/analyze_review_performa.limitation: Open issue M2: fixed historical log/windows and obsolete Balanced profile label; do not use as current benchmark acceptance.

open-world:Tools/verify_foundation_qa.py.limitation: Expects FoundationQA.log, FoundationTests.log and exactly four historical automation results; writes qa_report.json.

open-world:Tools/verify_nature_review.py.limitation: Expects named existing logs, seven test successes, 32 guests and versioned manifests; writes a new evidence snapshot and advances qa_report.json.

open-world:Tools/discover_pcg_mcp.py.limitation: Also reads previously saved PCGToolset, SceneTools, EditorAppToolset and ProgrammaticToolset discovery JSON. Seed these via actual native tool discovery before running.

world-framework:src/arcore_world_framewo.limitation: The current helper assumes the documented 2017-grid/8 km world; adapt and validate before use with other terrains.

world-framework:Unreal/ArcoreFrameworkRu.limitation: Asynchronous GPU/thread observations; angle is associated with the previously submitted camera, not an exact GPU frame ID.

sources.ownership: Consuming project adapters, procedural fixtures and validation harnesses
